title: Working on arrays
description:
Write in `solution.c`. Every function receives the array and how many elements it has:

```c
long long sum(const int values[], size_t count);
size_t index_of_max(const int values[], size_t count);       /* the first one if several tie; count >= 1 */
void reverse(int values[], size_t count);                    /* in place */
size_t count_above(const int values[], size_t count, int limit);
```

Add `#include <stddef.h>` for `size_t`.
hints: For `reverse`, swap the first and last elements, then the second and second to last, moving inwards until the two positions meet. Careful: with `count` 0, `count - 1` on a `size_t` is a huge number.
